title: VersionGraphNodeWithdrawn.v1
description: A version node was withdrawn from the DAG. Consumed in parallel (choreography): ms-change-summary invalidates summaries, ms-engagement-index retargets offers, ms-publish-fanout cancels in-flight work (RF-111).
$comment: Source: DISENO 4.3 catalog EV-04; RF-004, RF-070, RF-071, RF-111; US-01.3.1, US-03.3.4. Producer: ms-template-catalog. Consumers: ms-engagement-index, ms-change-summary, ms-publish-fanout. Channel: global EventBridge bus -> rule -> SQS of ms-change-summary; global bus -> cell EventBridge buses (whitelist) -> one rule per consumer -> SQS. Ordering/partition key: templateId + templateSeq. Idempotency key: eventId; (templateId, templateSeq). Guarantee: at-least-once. Versioning: additive within v1 (DISENO 4.2). dataClass: TEMPLATE_PUBLIC (DISENO 4.3). Crosses regions (whitelisted in the EventBridge rules); must not contain engagementId, firmId, userId or free text (contract test, DISENO 4.1).
x-channel: global EventBridge bus -> rule -> SQS of ms-change-summary; global bus -> cell EventBridge buses (whitelist) -> one rule per consumer -> SQS

templateSeq.description: templateSeq assigned by ms-template-catalog, monotonic per template (ADR-018, DEC-03). Consumers apply strictly in order (appliedSeq = templateSeq - 1). minimum 1 because template.last_seq starts at 0 (DISENO S1 V1__registry_baseline.sql).
